source: Retain the exact binary alpha and eight frozen normalized pair-source values in both carrier equations. Rounded mode uses the actual combined SRH/source rate; kernel/split/ideal add the independently specified constant source.
scope: All rows at base and trial 0, 5, 12 of each of four final rejected searches; exact production squared-norm differences and update rounding for all 13 trials.
coefficients: Fixed production double coefficients at each actual candidate; split and ideal are diagnostics, not accepted self-consistent states.
